svg.text: Three Candidate Layouts · Inner-Loop Equilibrium Convergence
fleet=7500, λ=30, κw=1.5 unified config; t=1 is the no-feedback burn-in point (translucent, excluded from the stable window);
shaded = stable window where the convergence criterion holds (t=2-5); dashed line = equilibrium value D*/W*/R*.
Convergence criterion checks D and W only (3 consecutive transitions with |ΔD%|<1% and |ΔW%|<5%); R is not a criterion variable — it stabilizes naturally.
